主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of certain Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, denominated in U.S. dollars. The filing includes two legal opinions: one from Norton Rose Canada LLP regarding Canadian, Ontario, and Quebec law, and another from Morrison & Foerster LLP concerning the validity of the Notes under New York law. The report is filed under the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is dated March 6, 2012, and is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement. The report is signed by two authorized officers of the Bank.
